MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The stainless wood screws fit my recent interest in long screws for construction and outdoor fastening.",
    "Their corrosion-resistant material makes sense alongside the rust-resistant outdoor screws I recently explored, provided the diameter and length fit my job."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Epoxy and super glue join materials, but I am currently choosing nails, screws, and anchors for mechanical fastening, with no specific adhesive repair in mind.",
    "The gauge, magnets, electronic cleaner, and temperature controller require particular tasks that my recent activity does not suggest.",
    "Weather-resistant duct tape shares an outdoor-use feature with my screws, but patching or sealing is a different need from fastening wood."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in construction supplies seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or maintenance product.",
    "Shared features such as strength, durability, or outdoor use seem to matter too much when the products serve different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated interest in framing nails, wood screws, and wall anchors points most clearly toward fastening and mounting work.",
    "Fastener dimensions, material, and compatibility matter to my choice; even the recommended wood screws need those checks.",
    "The medicine cups and vacuum bags reflect separate practical needs, rather than a reason to assume I want unrelated maintenance supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical supplies but broadened my fastening needs into unrelated repair and workshop tasks."
}
